build_ConcatActComponent: build a ConcatActComponent that concatenates context from multiple components in a specified order
create_get_action_attempt: create an action attempt by concatenating component contexts and querying the language model
test_get_context_concat_order: test the ConcatActComponent to verify the component concatenation order is correct
refactor_get_action_attempt: refactor get_action_attempt to support additional output types beyond FREE, CHOICE, and FLOAT
review_set_state: review the set_state method to restore component order and configuration from a saved state dictionary
